import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long v;
    static long[] seq = new long[17];

    static int solve(int index, long val) {
        val = Math.abs(val);
        if (index == 0) {
            return (int) val;
        }
        int base = (int) (val / seq[index]);
        int next_base = base + 1;
        int costA = base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, val - base * seq[index]);
        int costB = next_base * (index + 1) + solve(index - 1, val - next_base * seq[index]);
        return Math.min(costA, costB);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        v = sc.nextLong();
        seq[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) {
            seq[i] = seq[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        System.out.println(solve(16, v));
        sc.close();
    }
}
